patch_description: Replace heuristic center-nudging with direct nonlinear constrained optimization. Candidate center layouts are generated from several hexagonal lattice row patterns (plus deterministic jittered variants for diversity), then each candidate is refined by SLSQP over all 78 variables (26 x, 26 y, 26 radii) directly maximizing the sum of radii subject to wall and non-overlap constraints. This is fundamentally different from the prior Gauss-Seidel radius growth + center nudging: the optimizer simultaneously moves centers and grows radii along the true gradient of the objective, escaping the local traps where growing one circle blocks others. A final feasibility repair step slightly shrinks radii to guarantee strict validity. Multi-start over diverse layouts provides robustness.
